data.name: faqs-text
data.DebugDisplay: For more information and troubleshooting, visit our FAQ.

data.name: load-careers-content-text
data.DebugDisplay: You now have the ability to load careers from Football Manager 24 or 26 and continue your story.

data.name: loading-times-content-text
data.DebugDisplay: It may take slightly longer to load a career from Football Manager 24 or 26 for the first time as we make it compatible.

data.name: compatibility-content-text
data.DebugDisplay: When you bring your career into FM27, most features will be compatible, but some may not be populated with existing FM24 or FM26 data.

data.name: achievements-content-text
data.DebugDisplay: Achievements cannot be unlocked in FM27 while playing a career from FM24 or FM26.
